findings.description: A viewer can delete expenses. POST /expenses/{id}/delete as the viewer is accepted (303 redirect to /expenses, no 403) and the expense is actually removed. Other write requests by the viewer (POST /expenses, POST /expenses/{id}) are correctly refused with 403.
repro: Send POST /expenses/1/delete with the viewer session cookie
After a while the list no longer contains 'Train to Pune' and the total has dropped by $42.50

findings.description: After adding, editing or deleting an expense the list and total do not update: the redirected page shows the success flash ('Expense saved'/'Expense updated') but still the old rows and old total, and reloads (also from a new session) keep showing stale data for roughly 50 seconds. The change only appears later (measured ~54 s for an added row). The journey requires the new amount to show straight away.
repro: Open /expenses/3/edit, change the amount to 20.00, save
Redirected to /expenses?flash=updated: row still shows $12.99 and total unchanged
Reload repeatedly / sign in again: still old values for about a minute, then the new amount appears

findings.description: The edit form does not preselect the expense's current category: the Category select always defaults to the first option (travel). Editing only the amount of a meals/office expense therefore silently changes its category to travel (e.g. Team lunch went from meals to travel after an amount-only edit), which also corrupts category filters.
repro: Category shows 'travel'; change only the amount and save
After the list refreshes, Team lunch is listed under travel

findings.description: Submitting the add-expense form with invalid data (empty title, negative or non-numeric amount, unknown category) returns HTTP 400 and re-renders a blank form with no error message, and the user's entered values are discarded.
repro: POST /expenses with title='' and amount=-5 (bypassing browser validation)
Response is 400 with the form re-rendered, no error text, fields emptied

notes: Viewer list, total sum and category filter looked correct (filtered total equals filtered sum). Not tested: editor delete behavior in detail, visual/responsive layout. My own test edits (items renamed/added: 'QA test item', 'QA add two', 'Delay probe', 'x') remain in the data.
